uncited: This family reconstructs 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes from uncalibrated or sparse image collections without relying on external Structure-from-Motion pipelines [6136-instantsplat.md, 6137-anysplat.md, 6464-pixelsplat.md, 6888-joint-pose-optimization.md].

It sets itself apart from traditional 3DGS by eliminating iterative pose estimation, and from feed-forward alternatives by either initializing Gaussians via foundation model priors [6136-instantsplat.md] or jointly optimizing poses as learnable parameters [6888-joint-pose-optimization.md].
Choose this variant when the input camera poses are noisy and require robust feature alignment similar to SHARE.
The family originates from the need to generalize 3D Gaussian Splatting beyond single-scene optimization, which is computationally expensive and requires accurate initial poses [6464-pixelsplat.md].

Early work like [pixelSplat](6464-pixelsplat.md) introduced feed-forward architectures to predict Gaussian primitives directly from image pairs, addressing the local minima issues of traditional splatting [6464-pixelsplat.md].

Subsequent developments like [InstantSplat](6136-instantsplat.md) and [AnySplat](6137-anysplat.md) incorporated foundation model priors to enable pose-free reconstruction from sparse or uncalibrated views, significantly reducing training time to seconds [6136-instantsplat.md, 6137-anysplat.md]. [Joint Pose Optimization](6888-joint-pose-optimization.md) provides an alternative by treating poses as learnable parameters rather than predicting them via a network [6888-joint-pose-optimization.md].

These methods are used in generalizable novel view synthesis, 3D object reconstruction from sparse views, and applications requiring real-time rendering from casual captures [6464-pixelsplat.md, S1, unofficial].
